cautions.en: Prices are shown excluding VAT (HT); an annual-billing equivalent was not distinguished from monthly pricing on the page reviewed, so annualPerMonth is left null pending re-verification.

limitations.en: Monthly transfer counts are capped per plan; higher transfer volume requires upgrading tiers.
No free plan; only a 30-day trial before billing begins.
